name: rook_on_open_file
description: The side to move has a rook on a file with no pawns of either color, while the opponent has no such rook.
source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'rook_on_open_file'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has a rook on a file with no pawns of either color, while the opponent has no such rook.'
def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm
    
    def rook_on_open_file(color):
        for rook_sq in board.pieces(chess.ROOK, color):
            file_idx = chess.square_file(rook_sq)
            has_pawn = False
            for rank in range(8):
                sq = chess.square(file_idx, rank)
                p = board.piece_at(sq)
                if p and p.piece_type == chess.PAWN:
                    has_pawn = True
                    break
            if not has_pawn:
                return True
        return False
    
    stm_has = rook_on_open_file(stm)
    opp_has = rook_on_open_file(opp)
    
    return stm_has and not opp_has
